bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Threat is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting.

abilities.name: Error
abilities.text: The Servitor is Exhausted for 1 Round. This can be negated by an ally succeeding on a DN 3 Tech (Int) Test.

options.name: Gun Servitor
options.text: The Adeptus Mechanicus also equips Combat Servitors for ranged combat. Gun Servitors have Ballistic Skill 5 and a Heavy Bolter instead of a Servo Arm. (p.335)
